Q. The FAO accords the status of ‘Globally Important Agricultural
Heritage System (GIAHS)’ to traditional agricultural systems. What
is the overall goal of this initiative?

1. To provide modern technology, training in modern farming methods and
financial support to local communities of identified GIAHS so as to greatly
enhance their agricultural productivity.
2. To identify and safeguard eco-friendly traditional farm practices and their
associated landscapes, agricultural biodiversity and knowledge systems of
the local communities.
3. To provide Geographical Indication status to all the varieties of
agricultural produce in such identified GIAHS.

Select the correct answer using the code given below:

(a) 1 and 3 only
(b) 2 only
(c) 2 and 3 only
(d) 1, 2 and 3

questions.question:

b) Statement II: Some rare earth elements have phosphorescent properties.
 Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?

a) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains
Statement I
b) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct but Statement II does not explain Statement I
c) Statement I is correct but Statement II is not correct
d) Statement I is not correct but Statement II is correct
questions.chapter: Rare earth elements
questions.answer: (a) Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
